items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Yeah, now wait now, that name is familiar now, Henry Zeno.

ctx.x: If you don't have no time, no time to go nowhere. Time was too short. They let you play for it and take a 20 minute break where when you get back on the bandstand you feel like working. But 15 minutes, it takes you almost five minutes to get back to the dressing room. Because this one stopped you, that one stopped you, you know, and talking about different things. First thing you know it's almost time to get back up on the bandstand.
You remember another old time drummer, Zeno, Henry Zeno. Henry Zeno.

Yeah, now wait now, that name is familiar now, Henry Zeno. I'm trying to think who I used to hear him play with. Henry Zeno. Oh, I just can't come back to him now. In fact, I never did word with going around him too much because he wasn't playing that regular.
